name.ja: SDW HEROES 隠密ガンダムエアリアル

description.ja: 「ガンダム・エアリアル」×往年の名キャラクター「隠密頑駄無」×復活の輝羅鋼
description.en: "Gundam Aerial " x Famous Character of the Past " Kikkushi Gundam" x Revival of Kira Steel

description.ja: 待望の新旧要素を詰め込んだ新世代忍者、参上！
description.en: The long-awaited new generation ninja packed with new and old elements has arrived!

description.ja: ■輝羅鋼とは、射出成形とフィルムの貼り付けを同時に行うインモールド成形技術の応用。
description.en: • Kirakko is an application of in-mold molding technology that performs injection molding and film attachment at the same time.
• Comes with a full range of equipment.

description.ja: ■武装の組み替えで手裏剣を再現可能。
description.en: • Shuriken can be recreated by rearranging the weapons.

description.ja: ■可動に特化した内部フレームを内蔵。
description.en: • Built-in internal frame specialized for movement.

description.ja: ■肘の可動範囲により二刀流の構えが決まる。
description.en: • The range of motion of the elbows determines the stance of the dual wielder.

description.ja: ■別売りの「SDW HEROES 天下無双大将軍」との連動パーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes interlocking parts with "SDW HEROES Tenka Musou Taishogun" (sold separately).
